sideA.text:
DELIVERED: 551-700
Despite our inexperience, we did the impossible. The world has paid the price of our leaders’ fear, Utopia’s malice, and the Hollow Men’s savagery. But we have a cure! We believe that the world will recover in time. There will be new cities and new countries. Who knows how long it will take to rebuild, but we will be part of it.

DELIVERED: 401-550
We didn’t want to be back on the front lines so soon, but the world is a disaster. There is rioting, anarchy, near collapse. Without Utopia in the east, those cities have risen up. We have a cure but we’re not sure the world will survive long enough to use it. Some cities will make it. We hope the world can rebuild from there.

sideB.text:
DELIVERED: 400 AND BELOW
"I hope someone finds this note. The mistrust between Faded and normal humans was too much for the world. We were overwhelmed. There is a cure but it may be too little, too late. Our efforts were great but the burden was too heavy. We tried. We tried." – Found in ruins of North Atlantic Haven
